summary: Lands the wave-3 certified boolean-volume solver in the landed MONO-5 `membership` module (truck123d/src/bd_bridge.rs). The reduction is implemented exactly as the packet specifies: for an oriented boundary patch P the divergence form g_P = (1/3) P.(P_u x P_v) is integrated over the subset of P's parameter square whose image lies in the other solid; V(A n B) = sum_P int 1_B(P) g_P + sum_Q int 1_A(Q) g_Q and V(A \ B) = V(A) - V(A n B), with V(A) and V(B) taken from the landed per-patch flux certificate (`truck_certified::construct::volume_facts::certify_patch_form`, the same entry the binding's `volume_facts` export drives). The contact cover is built by control-hull range exclusion (theory eq. 11) over exact child control nets (de-Casteljau blossom subdivision); a cell outside the cover is certifiably clear and gets ONE MONO-5 membership witness (`classify_point`, retry contract) that fixes its constant membership, after which its exact child-net flux is scored through the landed machinery. Unresolved contact cells carry the certified bracket [min(0,g_lo), max(0,g_hi)] (the child density is taken with respect to the cell's own unit parameters, so the bracket is over unit area and is never rescaled by the parent cell area a second time) and are refined by descending bracket width until the summed width is within the per-patch budget (eq. 8). The broad phase is the control-hull pair test; the transversality admission is the sampled minimum normal-angle sine on the surviving pairs; the Amendment-1 EXTREMES-SURVIVE gate certifies bbox(A \ B) = bbox(A) from the two certified control hulls (a reached axis extreme refuses ExtremeSlabContaminated); the constructive solid count answers solids() = [self] (Amendment 1); and every consumed patch certifies unit weights (Amendment 4), a non-unit weight refusing RationalWeights. All cargo rides the existing queue; no OCC anywhere; corpus references are read-only. Six in-crate tests land the box/box closed forms, the contact-cover report, the crossing-box contact case, the extreme-slab refusal and the rational/malformed typed refusals. Full lib suite: 74 passed, 0 failed (serial).

implementation.public_surface: `membership::BooleanVolumeOptions` (relative_tolerance, max_depth, cover_depth, separation_depth, max_cells, classify_seed, enforce_bbox_certificate; Default = 1e-4 / 12 / 4 / 14 / 500k / deterministic seed / gate on), `membership::BooleanVolumeRefusal` (NonRegularPatch, TransversalityUncertified, MembershipIndeterminate, BudgetExceeded, ExtremeSlabContaminated, MalformedPatch, RationalWeights), `membership::ParamCell`, `membership::BooleanVolumeCertificate` (two-sided bracket, value, width, relative_width, V(A), V(B), intersection bracket, bbox, bbox_margin, solid_count, per-phase work [broad, exclusion, refinement], clear/contact/cover cell counts, max depth), `membership::contact_cover(patch, others, depth)`, and `membership::certify_boolean_volume(a, b, options)`.
implementation.reduction: `cell_flux_exact` reconstructs the exact child control net of the patch over the cell (`sub_net`, the tensor-product blossom/de-Casteljau subdivision), builds a unit-weight `TensorBernsteinPatch` over the unit square and runs the landed `certify_patch_form` with the recorded orientation; the 2-form is parameterization invariant, so the unit-square integral equals the parent's integral over the cell. `certify_boolean_volume` sums these over both boundary families.
implementation.contact_cover: `control_range` / `derivative_range_u` / `derivative_range_v` take the component hulls of the exact child net and its derivative control nets (the Bernstein convex-hull property: the tight certified enclosure of the image/derivatives over the cell). `ranges_separate` is the coordinate-range exclusion. `q_has_contact` subdivides the other patch's domain until either a coordinate range separates or the sub-box is no larger than the P-cell (then it is a conservative contact candidate), with a per-pair box cap; `is_clear` requires every other patch to separate. `cover_boxes` subdivides the patch's own square to the requested depth and keeps the non-clear cells; `contact_cover` exposes it. The integration seeds from the cover (cells disjoint from the cover are clear without a separation search) and re-tests `is_clear` on every refinement child, so clear-but-covered cells are still resolved exactly.
implementation.refinement: `integrate_patch` is a max-width priority worklist. A clear cell is scored exactly after its single membership witness (`clear_flux`); a contact cell contributes `contact_bracket` and is split along its wider axis while the summed contact width exceeds the per-patch budget. Depth and work caps turn an unclosable budget into the typed BudgetExceeded, never a stretched tolerance.
implementation.gate_and_admission: `extremes_survive` requires each of A's six certified axis extremes to lie outside B's certified axis range, returning the minimum separation margin (the bbox certificate) and refusing ExtremeSlabContaminated otherwise. `sigma_min` samples the unit normals on a 3x3 grid of each pair and takes the minimum cross-product sine; a value below TRANSVERSALITY_MIN refuses TransversalityUncertified.
implementation.typed_refusals: MalformedPatch / RationalWeights / NonRegularPatch come from `parse_patch` and the orientation/degree checks; MembershipIndeterminate from the MONO-5 retry contract; BudgetExceeded from the refinement work caps; ExtremeSlabContaminated and TransversalityUncertified from the two gates above.
